page0.text:
"SHINJI!!!"
I close in on him.
He has no shadows protecting him.
Just a few more steps...maybe three more meters, and I can—
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-06:page0:1

page1.text:
"S-stop! Don't come near me!"
Shinji turns and runs.
The moment I reach out to grab his back...
"Gh—!?"
I feel a chill run through my entire body, and I quickly jerk my arm back.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-06:page1:1

page2.text:
Something cuts through the air.
A black blade slices through the space I'd been occupying just an instant before.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-06:page2:1

page3.text:
"Guh...!"
I stop.
I don't know where she came from, but standing in front of me now...
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-06:page3:1

page4.text: ...I see the woman dressed in ominous black so dark even the most venomous shade of crimson seems pale in comparison.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-06:page4:1

page5.text:
"Ah..."
My mind goes blank with fear.
I'm going to die.
I don't want to think about it, but the image of my own brutal death fills my head.
I sense it.
I sense only death... The shadows earlier were nothing like this.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-06:page5:1

page6.text: "G-good, Rider! Don't hold back. You can do whatever you want with him!"
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-06:page6:1

page7.text:
Rider's form blurs.
I need to...
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-06:page7:1
